environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 7 service on ECS Fargate. LaunchDarkly SDK initialized with server-side key dk-staging-7b3e1. The flag 'enable-direct-model-bind' exists in the 'staging' environment but note: the SDK is configured with offline mode disabled and streaming connection active. The flag's targeting is ON with zero individual targets, zero segment rules, and the fallthrough (default) rule set to variation index 1 which maps to boolean false. The flag has a single prerequisite flag 'migration-window-active' which itself evaluates to false unless a maintenance window cron job flips it (next scheduled: 2025-Q3). SDK fallback (defaultValue parameter in code) is also false. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary that denies launchdarkly:PutFlagSetting for non-CI principals, preventing runtime flag modification via the LD API.

config.permission_boundary_effect: Deny launchdarkly:PutFlagSetting for principals not matching aws:PrincipalTag/ci-role=true
